sources: https://img1.wsimg.com/blobby/go/33823a15-c1dd-4855-8231-e746e7f3f203/downloads/Campground%20registration%20form%202024.pdf (Town of Holden Beach 'Campground Registration' form, linked from the town page as 'Campground Registration Form')

values.note: The town's rate changes by month: 1 day $36 in January, $45 Feb/Dec, $54 Mar/Nov, $63 Apr/Oct, $72 May/Sep, $81 Jun/Aug, $90 July; 30 days $800 (January) to $2,000 (July). Up to 4 people a site, $5 a night for each extra person; a card payment adds a 3% site fee; no refunds.

fees.source: https://img1.wsimg.com/blobby/go/33823a15-c1dd-4855-8231-e746e7f3f203/downloads/Campground%20registration%20form%202024.pdf ('CAMPSITE RENTAL RATE 30 DAYS 1 DAY', 'Maximum 4 people to a site', 'Over 4 people-$5.00 extra per night', 'If paying with Credit Card 3% site fee applies'; the town's 2024 form, still the one linked on hbtownhall.com), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://hbtownhall.com/parks-%26-recreation ('Currently the Town of Holden Beach has six camping sites available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve with the town's registration form by phone (910) 842-6488 or email, Monday-Friday 8:00-4:30; check that space is available before paying. A specific site cannot be guaranteed. Arriving after hours or on a weekend, pay by mail before arrival. No refunds.

booking.source: https://hbtownhall.com/parks-%26-recreation ('To make reservations for the campground, pleased download the form below and call (910) 842-6488 or email reception@hbtownhall.com, Monday -Friday between 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m.'; 'You must first make sure that there is space available before making payment'; 'We have a no refund policy') + the registration form ('A certain campsite cannot be guaranteed'), read 2026-10-22

note:
Located on the Holden Beach barrier island directly on the Atlantic Ocean.  --AWH
At the Holden Beach pier, 441 Ocean Blvd W; one vehicle per site, otherwise paid parking in the pier lot. --Claude
summary: Town of Holden Beach page and its registration form: confirmed 6 sites; added the town's month-by-month rate ($36 January to $90 July a night, 2024 form) and phone/email booking (Mon-Fri, no refunds). Not stated: hookups, facilities, a season statement (the rate table covers every month), max rig length.
flags: Website: the first link is Brunswick County's tourism listing (https://www.ncbrunswick.com/places-to-stay/camping-rv/), a directory; the operator's own page is the town's https://hbtownhall.com/parks-%26-recreation (already the second link). Drop the county listing.
Name: the town calls it 'The Holden Beach Campground' ('Come visit The Holden Beach Campground at the HB Pier!'); the county tourism listing uses 'Holden Beach Pier Campground'.
A 2023 Campendium review calls the pier campground permanently closed; the town's 2026 page still takes reservations for six sites, so it is open (aggregator claim disregarded).
